trailhead.label: Vöran village centre, by the parish church (official start; free parking at the church)

cautions: About 600 m on the provincial road SP98 (Vöraner Straße), 147 m of it signed 90 km/h with no pavement.
Village and farm roads with cars, about 600 m.
Bare porphyry rock on the summit, dropping steeply towards the village.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
